lines.text: Leo pulled his boot laces tight in the cold parking lot.
The lace had been fraying at the top hook for months.
He knotted the two short ends together and walked the whole hike in a loose, sloppy boot.
Before winter, run your fingers along each lace where it rubs the eyelets.
Carry one spare lace in your pack.
Next weekend, his boots held tight.
Save this before your next hike.
